name: Alfántega (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, blue above with a white Maltese cross at the upper fly and yellow below with a black scorpion at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Alfántega; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Maltese cross at the upper fly
